description:
`http-relay` is a transparent proxy: the UnitySVC gateway authenticates your call with your svcpass key, then forwards the request unchanged to an HTTP endpoint you own — swapping your svcpass credential for your upstream's on the way out.

Relaying to your own endpoint means UnitySVC never stores what passes through and takes no commission on it. `http-relay` is a multi-channel service: the free `http_relay` channel forwards every call to one endpoint you store once as customer secrets, while the metered `plus` channel lets you run many relays under a single account — each enrollment binds its own upstream `base_url` and is reached at a unique `/e/<code>` URL. The relay accepts any request format and forwards it byte-for-byte, so whatever your upstream speaks works. See “How to use this service” for both channels, credential handling, and code examples.
name: http-relay

payout_price.description: No platform commission — customer uses own endpoint
